text: {"final": {"summary": "In register_household (registry/register.py), added a validation check that runs only when the caller supplied an 'id' in the record: if is_valid_household_id (imported from core/ids.py) fails, it raises ValueError with a message including the rejected ID (f\"invalid household id {record['id']!r}\"). The check runs before the auto-assignment via next_household_id, before the duplicate-id check, and before any append/save_households call, so nothing is persisted when an ID is rejected. Auto-assigned IDs are never checked, so registering without an ID keeps working.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
